about: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited manufactures and sells freight and passenger rail systems in India and internationally. The company offers forged wheel set, cast bogies, couplers, draft gear, loco shells, and cast manganese steel crossing products; flat, hopper, tank, box, automobile-carrying, covered, and special purpose wagons; and brake vans. It also provides passenger rolling stock products, including semi high-speed trains, electric multiple unit train sets, urban metro rail system - aluminum
